messages:
nina: Quick alert: planning SDK 3.2 unpin in eu-west tonight 23:00 PT. Found a quant/kernel mismatch that affects qv2-mini models; proposing sticky runtime pin for that model-group until microkernel patch lands.
ash: OK. Suggest narrow slices and keep qv2-mini pinned. 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m.
peter: I'll add holdlist and explicit routing for qv2-mini to runtime v2.14.1+kvpatch. opsctl: opsctl holdlist add qv2-mini --reason "quant-kernel-mismatch" --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z
sre-bot: Created runtime pin: runtime:2.14.1+kvpatch scope=model-group:qv2-mini ttl=36h id=pin-2033. Reserving 2 canary pods in eu-west and 1 in eu-central. Healthcheck target 200rps. Runbook attached.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: SDK unpin (eu-west) @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. Escape hatch: deploy-bot rollback --id sdk-unpin-eu-west --reason telemetry-trigger
support: Please prepare a short CS note template in case of rollback.
nina: Rollback thresholds: 1) 5xx +0.5% vs baseline, 2) p95 latency +30% for qv2-mini after routing, 3) TER/oom spike, 4) eval drift >4% on core prompts. If any trigger, abort and re-pin.
peter: Holdlist and pin active, warming canaries now.
sre-bot: Canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. Advancing per plan, will page on alerts.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: slice=10%. Monitoring links posted.
sre-bot: pod-2 healthy -> moving to 50% after cooldown. No alerts so far.
nina: Thanks. I'll draft release notes and include expected p95 bump ~10% for pinned qv2-mini. Follow-up: schedule compatibility smoke for other model groups in 48h.
